rendered:
The paper says serum samples were collected from three enrolled subjects[1]. These were septic patients with confirmed E. coli infection, septic patients with confirmed E. faecium infection, and healthy volunteers serving as the control[2]. Read literally, that means just a single subject per group, so only the septic subjects were patients and the other was a healthy control. The plural wording ("patients", "volunteers") makes this a little unclear, and the paper gives no other enrolment count.

The many points in the LDA plot (Fig. 5[3] panel c) are repeat measurements, not more patients: each serum sample was measured repeatedly, and the points correspond to technical replicates[4]. This is a small proof-of-concept test, not a clinical study.
